run_primitive_narrowphase: run the primitive_narrowphase function to compute collision contacts between primitive geom pairs
build_plane_sphere_collision: build a plane-sphere collision check using plane_sphere_wrapper with contact distance and position output
build_box_box_collision: build a box-box collision check using box_box_wrapper with up to 8 contact points
build_capsule_capsule_collision: build a capsule-capsule collision check using capsule_capsule_wrapper with two contact points
build_plane_convex_collision: build a plane-convex collision check using plane_convex_wrapper with support-point vertex search
